notes: Corner lights now judge a corner your reference takes flat: taken flat it is green, because you matched the reference - it used to be blank, which looked the same as no data. Brake where the reference is flat and it goes amber for a dab, red for a real stop. Highlights no longer log every field event twice when a recording was started before SMART. Your desktop can no longer end up in a highlight clip: the display-capture layer is switched off while GOAT re-records camera angles from the replay. SMART remembers the brake bias you actually ran - it is adjusted from the cockpit and saved into no setup file, so GOAT reads it live and tells you what you used last time you were at that car and track. The finished video is findable: the Highlights panel names it and opens its folder, and it is named by when it was made. Also: the Stint window shows the turns that fit with the corner you are approaching in the middle and its text grows with the window; the Corners window has a 3/5/7 turns button and a GEAR caption, and a two-digit turn no longer pushes the arrow out of line; the Drill panel no longer overlaps its own text; the radar redraws at 33 ms rather than 60 plus the work it had just done; iRacing qualifying no longer calls cars closing behind you; and the chequered flag no longer says the session is over before you cross the line.
